4.caption: Talk To Principal
4.text: Look, kid.<.><NEWLINE>I just don't like you, ok?<NEWLINE>I worked hard and got this job, because it put me in a position of power. My decisions will change your entire fate.<NEWLINE>I can decide on a whim whether you end up homeless in a gutter, or a Wall Street millionaire investment banker.<NEWLINE>Up to me!<.>And guess what? I just decided that I don't like your face.<NEWLINE>Oops! Too bad. You lose.<NEWLINE>So now, no matter what you do, no matter how hard you try, well, you're never going to get anywhere. Mark my words.<.>You think that's not fair? You think it's not fair? Tell that to Johnny Parkins, back in '83.<NEWLINE>Johnny thought it was really funny to steal my girl. Hilarious.<NEWLINE>And you know what? You kind of look a little bit like Johnny.<NEWLINE>So that's it, kid.

6.caption: Talk To The Baby
6.text: Hello baby! You're certainly in for a surprise!<NEWLINE>First of all, I'm going to let you know straight away that you were a complete accident.<NEWLINE>You might think "not me!" but that's simply the case for 99% of humans!<NEWLINE>You see, nobody actually wants children. Sometimes they are overcome by hormones and delusionally proclaim that they do!<NEWLINE>This is just another intinctual emotion, not something people actually want, but something their body is controlling them to say and do.<NEWLINE>Our parents, like every other paired couple with offspring on this planet, just couldn't control their biological addictions, and were overcome in a humiliating moment of lost control, compulsively slamming engorged appendages into random orifices and spraying biohazardous material all over each other.<NEWLINE>As ashamed as they were, they couldn't help but to continue repeating this revolting process endlessly, occasionally deluding themselves into believing it is something they are doing of their own volition.<NEWLINE>You are their living mark of shame! Look at the cute baby! Look at the humiliating submission into animal instinct! Look at the loss of integrity and conviction!<NEWLINE>Yay! You destroyed our dreams! We're so happy! This is everything we ever wanted! Life is so great now!<NEWLINE>The best part is, that while you were a complete accident, now you'll be forced into a system against your will where you will be tortured for the next 3 decades without a say in the matter. <NEWLINE>You won't ever get anything you want, you'll never get any time off, you'll never escape, and you'll be a complete slave until you fall victim to this delusional process yourself and create yet another hapless victim together with an unsuspecting partner, just as compulsive and pathetic as yourself.<NEWLINE>Life is wonderful, because if we didn't keep telling ourselves that, we might all sink into a suicidal depression, and that, fortunately, has been outlawed. <NEWLINE>Sleep tight! Mommy and Daddy love you very much!

7.caption: Talk To Brother
7.text: Hey Bro. Have you seen one of my boxes in here? The one with the lotion in it? Yeah. Dude, that's disgusting. Get it out of here and keep it in your room. GET OUT!!!

8.caption: Use The Toilet
8.text: Man, toilets are weird. Why can't we come up with something better than this?

9.caption: Look At The TV
9.text: It's playing the Suburban Housewives Talk Show, a show designed to shape the opinions of bored suburban housewives. Some wealthy, sociopathic looking women wearing heavy makeup are sitting around a table telling the audience what they should think about various topics.

10.caption: Look At The TV
10.text: It's playing the Home Improvement Shopping Channel. A rough, macho looking alpha male with a gruff voice is describing how to endlessly add value to your household, while avoiding interaction with your family on the weekends. This is designed to satiate the human male instinct to preen their nest and demonstrate dominance towards the family units nearby. Oh, look. It's a pile of bricks! Manly bricks!

11.caption: Look In The Fridge
11.text: The fridge is stuffed to the brim, but there's nothing to eat! Literally, it is stuffed with plastic containers filled with moldy leftovers of questionable edibility.

12.caption: Look At The Alarm Clock
12.text: It's an alarm clock.  Some people believe the atomic bomb was a bad invention, and others believe the invention of gunpowder was the worst.  The truth is, the simple alarm clock is definitively the utmost devastating invention ever devised by mankind, forcing billions of humans to become slaves to a single blinking LED, taking away any control they may have had over their vital biological needs.  It's like a toilet that slams shut halfway through, that everyone has somehow enthusiastically accepted into their lives.  Inventions like these could only have been created by the most evil of madman.

13.caption: Use Old Computer
13.text: The cursor was spinning when I got here.  It doesn't look like it's going to stop anytime soon.

14.caption: Talk To Librarian
14.text: Hey.  Uh, so what is this place?  It's a library!  You mean, like, iTunes?  No, it's a place where you can borrow books.  Isn't that illegal?
